scope: Offline model comparison for narration on the ONE shared public development package. Development data only; never independent final acceptance. No product-quality claim is made here.

devPackage.note: 01 owns the single frozen manifest/rubric for lanes 11 and 12. This draft records hashes as observed while 01 was still editing; it does not freeze or fork the package.
devPackage.finalityRule: A batch may start only after 01 marks the package final and the manifest/cases/rubric sha256 above are re-read and pinned in preregistration.v1.json. Any change afterwards creates a new version and keeps old results.

condition.chatWrapper: lane 10 chatml-instruct-v1: system text + 【已结算输入】 + serialized input + 请写出这一回合的正文。
condition.templateApplication: each model's own GGUF chat template via llama-server --jinja; the model never receives a hand-pasted ChatML string
condition.whitespaceRule: delete space/tab/U+3000 exactly like the browser path; every removal recorded in the prompt ledger
condition.subsetPolicy: No subset. All 15 declared cases must serialize; a case the reference serializer refuses blocks the batch until 01 fixes or formally excludes it.
knownSerializerRefusals: tide-continuity-tide-duty-t2: 本回合变化/变化/沈砚 uses operation 任务 (reported to 01)
tide-continuity-tide-duty-t3: 本回合变化/变化/潮位计/解除外貌 is a string, not an array (reported to 01)
fixture-goggles-transfer: 本回合变化/变化/诺诺 uses operation 外貌 (reported to 01)
limitations: Whole-scene condition, not the product's current beat-scoped prompt (02's strategy). It is a model-comparison condition only; promotion still runs the real product page via 09.
Case priorTexts are used by the checker for echo detection, not inserted into the prompt. Cross-turn context is 04/07's scope.

subsetCoverage.warning: The excluded set removes the only item_transfer_fixture case and two of the three continuity cases. A 12-case result cannot claim item-transfer or full continuity coverage, even if it reaches a high pass count.

judging.reviewer: 01-input independent review; 05-kernel then 03-actions only as conflict-checked substitutes
judging.thisLane: produces raw text + mechanical aggregation; self-assessment is not acceptance

baselineImprovement.rule: at least 2 cases change from style_fail/fail to pass under the same condition
baselineImprovement.forbidden: deleting required facts, lowering severity, swapping in a looser checker

qualityGate.promotion: Only candidates passing this gate may be sent to 09 as browser-requests; a pass is eligibility for a small browser check, not product acceptance.

failureExits: any declared case refused by the serializer -> stop (no silent skip)
model sha256 mismatch or file size > 1,500,000,000 bytes -> stop
llama-server load failure -> record and drop that candidate, no retry loop
generation error/timeout in >2 cases -> record and stop that arm
no candidate reaches the quality gate -> keep the negative result and report; do not send a weaker candidate to 09 to fill the slot

runtimeConstraint.source: results/quality/team-08-runtime.json: browser Blob store aggregate cap ~2 GB; 1.3 GB blob OK, +1.2 GB fails; 2.5 GB single file fails; splitting does not bypass
runtimeConstraint.consequence: A candidate's file plus the page's other loaded models must stay under the measured cap for a real browser run. All batch-1 candidates are <=1.18 GB; the 1.5 GB single-file gate is aligned. No 4B retry is queued.

changeControl: Any change to candidates, template, sampling, max tokens, stop strings, or case set creates preregistration.v2 and a new batch id; old raw outputs stay.
